root_causes.description: Recommendation service exhibited extreme memory usage anomaly (z-score >1000) with memory working set at 1.06e+08 bytes vs baseline of 9.995e+07 bytes, alongside severe CPU usage spike (z=+810.80) from baseline of 0.02506 to window mean of 2.342, indicating resource exhaustion as the root cause

remediation_steps: Investigate and restart recommendation pods experiencing memory pressure
Review recommendation service code for memory leaks or unbounded resource consumption
Implement resource limits and requests for recommendation deployment
Monitor for recurrence and scale horizontally if needed
